rationale: Revokes EO 1367 (1911) (one-time, executed) and establishes part of Fort Wingate Military Reservation as a National Forest (Zuni District of Manzano NF), administered by Agriculture with War Department use preserved. EO 5752 cites 4208 as having modified the Manzano National Forest and renames it Cibola, so the forest was still treated as existing then, but that is not a current predicate for 2026-10-14. The order text itself carries no end; no revoking act is held. Original not yet held; replace and re-check quotes when an official copy is retrieved.
material_gaps: Held current source for the Zuni District / Fort Wingate lands (later transfer or revocation).
